text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hey there! I'm Digi-tan! It's finally the 
day of the "Make Debut." Seeing all these 
fresh, blooming Umamusume-chans gets me so 
stoked!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta run with everything I've got so 
I don't cast a shadow over their precious, 
special day!
